_about: Bombardier CRJ700 Airport Planning Manual (CSP B-020, Revision 15), 00-02-02 Figure 1 Aircraft Dimensions sheet 2: page index 31, layers.py --mode strokes --color 0,0,0 at scale 20, clip 70,105,460,390 (plan). Pixels of that raster, line centres; the upper half (the aircraft's right side, the same as its left). The tail cone runs on under the tailplane's root as a dashed line: bridged to its end. The stub pylon's leading edge is a short line between nacelle and fuselage; its trailing edge runs from the exhaust in to the fuselage. The plan view stops the wing where the winglet starts (a straight line across the tip, 11.17 m out).
